meta.promptText: Mujhe India mein 3000 rupees ke andar running shoes kharidne hain. Konse lene chahiye?

response.text:

Decathlon launches KIPRUN sub-brand in India to catch the 'running boom'; plans to reach 5 million runners by 2030
search_results.description: Decathlon India has launched its running-focused sub-brand, KIPRUN, aiming to capitalize on the growing popularity of running in the country. The company plans to build a business exceeding Rs 1,000 crore by 2030 and reach over 5 million active runners. Originally introduced globally in 2008, KIPRUN is now present in 70 countries. For its India launch, Decathlon has introduced 35 products under the running category, which includes running shoes, apparel, hydration packs, trail gear, and other accessories. Among these, 17 are performance running shoes, reflecting the brand's commitment to supporting both amateur and professional runners in India.

search_results.title: The best running shoes in 2026 - our top picks, tested by 3 runners
search_results.description: This 2026 review of the best running shoes provides top recommendations based on comprehensive testing by three experienced runners. The Asics Novablast 6 leads as the top pick for beginners due to its superb comfort, support, and upgraded energy return. The Nike Pegasus 42 is noted for its value, offering durability, comfort, and improved breathability with a full-length Air Zoom unit. For stability, the Saucony Hurricane 25 stands out with its subtle support suited for overpronators and injury-prone runners. The Nike Vomero Plus excels in cushioning, combining ZoomX foam with comfort and versatility for both long runs and tempo efforts. For speed, the New Balance SuperComp Rebel v1 delivers a lightweight, bouncy ride enhanced by a carbon-infused plate, though it is less stable and more expensive at $200. The article also evaluates alternatives, including the ultra-light but pricey Adidas Adios Pro Evo 3, versatile Puma Deviate Pure Nitro, and Hoka Clifton 11 for comfort-driven walkers. Overall, the guide offers something for every runner, from beginners to racers, emphasizing comfort, performance, and user suitability.
